files.role: human-readable package notes and claim boundary

measurement_definition.background_counts_definition: detector counts with device emission suppressed/blocked while retaining optical background and detector dark
measurement_definition.dark_counts_definition: detector dark diagnostic with optical path blocked; QC only and not subtracted again
measurement_definition.radiometric_factor_definition: emitted photons represented by one background-subtracted detector count for each channel; includes calibrated collection/detection chain
measurement_definition.sample_counts_definition: detector counts with device emission plus background and detector dark

uncertainty_convention.correlated_radiometric_scale: rows sharing correlation_group are not independent uncertainty terms
uncertainty_convention.reported_uncertainties: one-sigma standard uncertainties unless explicitly stated otherwise
